questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Give me blood and I will give you freedom"?
questions.explanation: The slogan is associated with Subhash Chandra Bose.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: Which is the longest river flowing within India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga (~2,525 km) is the longest river within India.

questions.question: The minimum age to become the President of India is:
questions.explanation: A presidential candidate must be at least 35 years old.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: Which amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the "Mini Constitution" for its sweeping changes.

questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which earlier body?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
questions.explanation: The President appoints the Chief Justice of India.

questions.question: Which part of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment.

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: In which sport is the term "googly" used?
questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: The term of a member of the Lok Sabha is normally:
questions.explanation: A Lok Sabha term is normally 5 years.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: The "Make in India" initiative was launched in:
questions.explanation: Make in India was launched in September 2014.

questions.question: Who decides the repo rate in India?
questions.explanation: The RBI sets the repo rate through its Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.question: Which element is essential for the formation of haemoglobin?
questions.explanation: Iron is essential for haemoglobin formation.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.A: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: Which is the densest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: World Water Day is observed on:
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India is appointed by the:
questions.explanation: The CAG is appointed by the President of India.

questions.question: Who is known as the "Father of the Indian Constitution"?
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the drafting committee.

questions.question: The Davis Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Davis Cup is a men’s team tennis event.

questions.question: Which is the smallest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area.

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons in the solar system.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.question: The national flower of India is the:
questions.explanation: The lotus is India’s national flower.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was led by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is a men’s international badminton team event.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: What is 5% of 380?
Find the simple interest on ₹2500 at 10% per annum for 3 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹2000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹600 is sold for ₹660. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹900 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 8.
Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 28. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 28/7 = 4. Larger = 5 × 4 = 20.

questions.question: A train 100 m long crosses a pole in 5 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/30 = 50/600. Time = 600/50 = 12 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 14 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √900.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹450. Find its marked price.
Find 10% of 10% of 1400.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 9 and their difference is 12. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 4 parts = 12, so each part = 3. Smaller = 5 × 3 = 15.

questions.question: A boat travels 56 km downstream in 4 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 56/4 = 14 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 14 − 2 = 12 km/h.

questions.question: Find the value of ∛343.
A train 180 m long crosses a platform 120 m long in 15 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 180 + 120 = 300 m in 15 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

questions.question: What is 25% of 260?
Find the simple interest on ₹2500 at 4% per annum for 4 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹1000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹400 is sold for ₹500. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹780 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 2.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 84. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 84/7 = 12. Larger = 5 × 12 = 60.

questions.question: A train 200 m long crosses a pole in 10 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
If today is Tuesday, what day will it be after 83 days?
questions.explanation: 83 mod 7 = 6; Tuesday + 6 = Monday.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th to the right of the 3rd letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 3rd letter = C; 3 + 8 = 11th letter = K.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (2, 13), (4, 64), (5, 125), (6, 216)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 2³ = 8, not 13.

questions.question: In a row of 37 students, Ravi is 10th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 37 − 10 + 1 = 28.

questions.question: Find the next term: 36, 49, 64, 81, 100, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 6²…10². Next is 11² = 121.

questions.question: Find the next term: 6, 9, 15, 24, 36, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 15, so 36 + 15 = 51.

questions.question: If LAMP is coded as PEQT, how is STAR coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to STAR gives WXEV.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 11² = 121, so 4² = 16.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km East and then 8 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 10 + 2 × 2.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 10 × 2 − 2 = 20 − 2 = 18.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 40 × 2 = 80.

questions.question: Complete the series: D, F, H, J, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 2 places, so the next is L.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 25, 13, 23
questions.explanation: 23, 3, 13 are prime numbers; 25 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 10th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 10th letter from the right is the 17th from the left = Q.
The relation is cubing: 4³ = 64, so 4³ = 64.

questions.question: If today is Monday, what day will it be after 16 days?
questions.explanation: 16 mod 7 = 2; Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 11th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 11th letter = K; 11 + 4 = 15th letter = O.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (9, 729), (3, 27), (8, 514), (5, 125)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 8³ = 512, not 514.

questions.question: In a row of 26 students, Ravi is 19th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 26 − 19 + 1 = 8.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 3²…7². Next is 8² = 64.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 35 + 13 = 48.

questions.question: If MOON is coded as QSSR, how is TREE coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to TREE gives XVII.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 1:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 1:00 the angle is 1 × 30° = 30°.
The relation is squaring: 9² = 81, so 9² = 81.
